title: Compactly supported direct image commutes with extension of coefficients
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$. Work in the standing scheme setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]: $X$, $Y$, and $\bar X$ are separated schemes of finite type over $k$, and all maps are $k$-morphisms. Let $f:X\to Y$ have a compactification $f=\bar f\circ j$, where $j:X\hookrightarrow\bar X$ is open and $\bar f:\bar X\to Y$ is proper. Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of finite commutative rings killed by a power of $\ell$.

Use the ordinary uncompleted module derived categories and constant coefficient sheaves of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $\Dctf(T_{\mathrm{proét}},R)$ for the full subcategory with bounded, intrinsically constructible cohomology [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf] and finite Tor amplitude [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. Write $K_B=K\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ with its $B_T$-action as in [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor], and $Rf_{!,R}=R\bar f_{*,R}j_{!,R}$, with extension by zero as in [def-weil-extension-by-zero].

For $M\in\Dctf(X_{\mathrm{proét}},A)$ the canonical coefficient comparison is an isomorphism, natural in $M$, in $\Dctf(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},B)$:
$$
b_{A,B}(M):(Rf_{!,A}M)_B=(R\bar f_{*,A}j_{!,A}M)\otimes^L_{A_Y}B_Y
\xrightarrow{\sim}R\bar f_{*,B}j_{!,B}(M\otimes^L_{A_X}B_X)=Rf_{!,B}(M_B).
$$
Here the proper comparison is the $B$-linear adjoint transpose of the $A$-counit after extension of scalars, followed by the canonical extension-by-zero tensor comparison; the derived adjunctions are those of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. There is no flatness or finite projective dimension hypothesis on $B$ over $A$.

For every further homomorphism $B\to C$ of finite commutative $\ell$-primary rings, the comparison for $A\to C$ satisfies
$$
b_{A,C}(M)\circ\alpha_{Rf_{!,A}M}
=Rf_{!,C}(\alpha_M)\circ b_{B,C}(M_B)\circ(b_{A,B}(M))_C,
$$
where $\alpha_K:(K_B)_C\xrightarrow{\sim}K_C$ is the associativity isomorphism of [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor].

proof.text: Obtain an ordinary bounded constructible etale origin L of M using finiteRing_constructibleDerived_origin. The exact open comparison identifies N=j!M with the comparison image of J=j!L. J is bounded below by exactness of etale extension by zero. Scalar extension preserves bounded constructibility and Tor amplitude of M. The open scalar isomorphism identifies the comparison image of the actual etale scalar extension J_B with j!M_B. Exactness of intrinsic extension by zero and reflection of cohomological intervals by the finite-ring comparison give the required lower bound on J_B without assuming coefficient flatness.

proof.text: Finite type over the field gives Noetherian Z and Y. Apply properIntrinsicFiniteCoefficientExtension to p, J and the two proved lower bounds. Naturality transports invertibility along the open-origin isomorphism to N=j!M. Expand b=Rp!e followed by gamma: its proper factor and the image of the open scalar isomorphism are invertible.

proof.text: For each of the input and output scalar extensions use scalarExtensionFunctor_preserves_constructible_tor. For each compact-support image, apply compactSupport_uniform_tor_bound after choosing a uniform finite geometric-fibre-dimension bound for f. The unit-normalized left-adjoint uniqueness isomorphism identifies its raw open factor with the recorded intrinsic extension by zero. Transport bounded cohomology, constructibility and Tor amplitude along this isomorphism. This proves all six endpoint membership conjuncts in intrinsic coefficients. The conversion between finite cohomological support and a finite interval is elementary order theory on the integers.

proof.text: Apply the proved proper and open coefficient cocycles. The private categorical assembly expands b=Rp_*(e) gamma, moves e through the second proper mate by naturality, and substitutes both factor cocycles. This gives exactly the coefficient cocycle with the two specified scalar associators.

Faults in the repair, fixed: (1) lem-sp-direct-image-change-ring-transpose called Res(gamma_N) the 'etale' projection morphism for arbitrary pro-etale N, through the D^+-only mate lemma. That clause is ill-posed. It is restated as: d∘r(gamma_N) is the pro-etale projection map with transpose eps^A_N⊗1, via the adjunct clause of lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction. (2) lem-sp-direct-image-etale-mate-isomorphism assumed only bounded-below K. Then H=K⊗^L B can be unbounded below (Z/l^2->F_l, K=F_l), so beta_H is outside the cited D^+ lemma, invertibility of pi_K is unsupported (lem-sf-projection-finite-constant needs D^-), and its last sentence restated item Step 8. It is restated with K,H in D^+: t has transpose eps^p_N⊗1, and t is an isomorphism if pi_K is. Its dependencies on the projection lemma and on node 1 are dropped. (3) Item Steps 6-8 are rewritten: t (an isomorphism by Steps 3 and 5) equals d∘r(gamma) because the adjoint transposes are equal; Res reflects isomorphisms, so b is an isomorphism. I also added lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization to Steps 2 and 11, because the pending blueprint_update of def-weil-extension-by-zero drops the localization clause those steps quote. There is no cycle and neither new node duplicates an existing one.
